messages:
jamie: Heads-up — planning next Tue 09:00 UTC release train slot. Deploy set = inference-runtime v2.3, router-service (canary), console UI patch. Who can own runtime deploy + smoke?
sarah: I can own console smoke and post-deploy sanity checks. What exact window?
jamie: 09:00-10:00 UTC. Plan: 10% canary for 15m, 50% for 10m, then full if green.
derek: I can take runtime. PRs ready: `#5123` (runtime), `#5130` (kv-cache fix). I'll run the runtime smoke: `/ops/smoke/runtime-smoke.sh` and watch cpu/latency dashboards.
maria: I’ll own router canary. Pushing `router:v1.8.1-canary` then `redwoodctl traffic set router 10%`. I’ll watch 5xx, p99 and error budget.
jamie: @derek @maria perfect — @sarah please add session-affinity and e2e search to console smoke checklist. Rollback thresholds: if p99 latency +25% over baseline OR error rate >0.5% then rollback.
sarah: Added checklist items to the runbook, will run quick curl health checks and embeddings sanity. Example quick check: `curl -s -f https://console.staging/health || echo fail`
derek: Runtime rollback command I’ll keep handy: `kubectl -n inference set image deploy/inference inference=registry/redwood/inference:2.2.9 --record`. Also taking KV snapshot before deploy: `snapctl save inference-2026-03-18`.
oncall-bot: Reminder: weekly-release window opens Tue 09:00 UTC. If a pager fires we auto-join incidents channel and escalate per SLO.
maria: Confirming no DB migration required — router change behind feature-flag only.
jamie: Nice. Can folks react with :thumbsup: if they can do the slot and add themselves as smoke owner in the runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/release-train
derek: :thumbsup: added to runbook and will post start/finish timestamps.
maria: :thumbsup: runbook entry done.
sarah: :thumbsup: added console smoke steps and small rollback playbook.
jamie: Final asks: add JIRA release epic `INFR-892` and drop a deploy-start comment when you go live. I’ll be on escalation for the slot. Thanks everyone.
